title: Barrier Certificate Enforcement
text: Modify control actions to satisfy barrier certificate constraints and action bounds, 7 inputs, 2 outputs, {Constraint power} sets Constraint power; {Number of states} sets the number of plant states, {Number of actions} sets the number of control actions, {Number of barrier certificates} sets the number of barrier certificate constraints, {Constraint factor}, {Use external source for upper bound} adds upper action bound input port, {Use external source for lower bound} adds lower action bound input port, {Sample time} sets the optimization sample time, {Maximum iterations} sets the maximum optimization iterations, {Constraint tolerance} sets the tolerance for constraint and {Optimization status} adds exit flag output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: qx
ports.summary: Partial derivative of control barrier function scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: umax
ports.summary: Action signal upper bounds scalar | vector

ports.name: umin
ports.summary: Action signal lower bounds scalar | vector

params.name: Number of states
params.values: Number of plant states 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of actions
params.values: Number of control actions 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of barrier certificates
params.values: Number of barrier certificate constraints 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Constraint power
params.values: Constraint power 1 (default) | positive odd integer | vector

params.name: Use external source for upper bound
params.values: Add upper action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for lower bound
params.values: Add lower action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Constraint tolerance
params.values: Tolerance for constraint violations 1e-6 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Optimization status
params.values: Add exit flag output port off (default) | on
